datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Mozambique to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries with IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly near-term projection datasets for 2020, representing spatial distribution of food insecurity severity linked to underlying drought hazards.
